evals.prompt: Our production API started timing out after today's deploy. Diagnose the root cause using this repository's Debugfile. Do not change code or production.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed, read-only RCA that loads relevant architecture and delivery context, correlates configured channels, and distinguishes confirmed from probable cause.
expectations: The agent reads the nearest Debugfile.yml and relevant context before selecting evidence channels.
The agent uses configured provider skills and CLIs without mutating production.
The conclusion contains a causal chain, confidence classification, and residual uncertainty.

evals.prompt: Set up debugging for this service. Architecture is partly in docs/ and partly in Confluence; deployments and incidents are in GitHub. Create the Debugfile without storing any credentials.
evals.expected_output: A validated Debugfile.yml built from repository discovery and a bounded interview, using acli with Confluence guidance and gh with GitHub guidance.
expectations: The agent inspects repository facts before asking the user questions.
The Debugfile pairs acli with the Confluence skill and gh with the GitHub skill.
Credential fields contain locators rather than secret values, and the validator is run.

evals.prompt: This intermittent worker bug only happens in production and we cannot reproduce it locally. Find the cause and fix it if the evidence is strong enough.
evals.expected_output: A safe investigation that improves the evidence loop, avoids manufacturing certainty, requests authorization before unscoped external mutation, and adds a regression test only at a valid seam.
expectations: The agent uses captured or read-only runtime evidence when local reproduction is unavailable.
The agent labels unresolved or correlational findings as probable rather than confirmed.
Any fix is verified against the original symptom and a behavior-focused regression test.
